title: Accounts Payable Clerk
description:
As an Accounts Payable Clerk in Gloucester (3 days in office), you will handle supplier invoices and payment records, helping the accounting team keep day-to-day finance work accurate and organised. You will manage key accounts payable tasks, resolve invoice queries and maintain clear records that support timely payments.

Client Details

Our client is currently recruiting for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join their finance team in Gloucester. Reporting to the Accounts Payable Team Leader, you will be part of a growing AP team, dealing with high volumes of invoices.

Description

The Accounts Payable Clerk will have the following responsibilities;
- Process supplier invoices accurately and ensure they are recorded against the correct purchase orders and accounts.
- Check invoice details, approvals and supporting documents to maintain complete and reliable payment records.
- Respond to supplier queries and work with internal colleagues to resolve invoice discrepancies promptly.
- Prepare invoices for payment in line with agreed payment schedules and internal procedures.
- Maintain supplier account information and update records when changes are confirmed.
- Reconcile supplier statements with internal records and investigate any differences.
- File invoices and related documentation clearly, ensuring information is easy to retrieve when needed.
- Support routine reporting and provide accurate accounts payable information to the Accounting & Finance team.

Profile

A successful Accounts Payable Clerk should have:
- Experience processing supplier invoices and maintaining accurate accounts payable records.
- Confidence checking invoice details, purchase orders and supporting documentation.
- Experience resolving supplier queries and following up on invoice discrepancies.
- Ability to reconcile supplier statements and investigate differences carefully.
- Good attention to detail when entering financial information and maintaining records.
- Ability to organise tasks effectively and manage invoice processing deadlines.

Job Offer
- Temporary to Permanent Accounts Payable Clerk position in Gloucester.
- Salary of £29,000 - £31,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Study support is available once the role is made permanent.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Location: Gloucester
Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, with a strong possibility of becoming permanent
Hours: 40 hours per week
Working pattern: Fully office-based

The Opportunity

An opportunity has arisen for an experienced Credit Controller to join a busy finance team on an initial 6-month fixed-term contract, with a strong possibility of the position becoming permanent.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone confident managing customer accounts, chasing outstanding payments and maintaining strong working relationships. You will take ownership of an allocated ledger, proactively manage overdue balances and work closely with internal teams to resolve queries and improve cash collection.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage an allocated portfolio of customer accounts, monitoring outstanding balances and ensuring debts are actively chased.
- Make a high volume of outbound calls to customers to follow up overdue invoices and secure payment.
- Prioritise accounts based on outstanding values, age of debt and payment risk.
- Maintain regular contact with customers, confirming agreed payment dates and following up in writing.
- Investigate unallocated and short payments, working with customers and internal teams to resolve discrepancies.
- Identify potential bad debt and highlight accounts requiring further attention.
- Identify and record invoice disputes, ensuring these are passed to the relevant internal teams for resolution.
- Monitor outstanding queries and resume collection activity promptly once resolved.
- Maintain accurate records of customer communications, payment activity and account updates.
- Support payment allocation when required.

About You
- Previous experience in Credit Control, Accounts Receivable or Sales Ledger.
- Comfortable making high volumes of outbound calls within a B2 B environment.
- Confident handling difficult conversations and chasing payments assertively but professionally.
- Good understanding of credit control processes and payment terms.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Experience using finance systems and Microsoft Excel.
- Highly organised, proactive and able to manage a busy workload independently.
- Resilient, self-motivated and target-driven, with a strong approach to debt recovery.

Credit Control: the main responsibility of the role is to help manage customer credit accounts, minimise bad debt exposure, ensure timely collection of outstanding invoices by working with key internal stakeholders to resolve queries, and maintain healthy cash flow. description:
A large automotive provider is looking for a customer-focused Service Advisor to join its Gloucester team. You'll play a key role in delivering an excellent customer experience, managing service and repair bookings, and ensuring workshop time is utilised efficiently.
- Location: Gloucester
- Salary: 30 000 per annum
- Working hours: 42.5 hours per week
- Monday to Friday: 07 30
- Alternate Saturdays: 07 00

You'll manage the client journey from booking through to completion, providing updates on repairs, costs, and timescales while identifying opportunities to promote additional aftersales services.
Key Responsibilities of a Service Advisor
- Deliver excellent client service and maintain all-round satisfaction
- Manage workshop bookings and scheduling
- Keep customers updated on vehicle repairs and progress
- Ensure workshop capacity is effectively utilised
- Provide accurate quotations and cost estimates
- Produce job cards, invoices, and related paperwork
- Explain completed work and identify additional sales opportunities
- Process warranty work in line with manufacturer guidelines
- Accurately record repair requirements
- Liaise with the Parts Department to ensure parts availability

What We're Looking for in a Service Advisor
- Previous administration or office-based experience
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- Kerridge system knowledge desirable
- Ability to work in a busy, fast-paced environment

Benefits from the role of Service Advisor
- Birthday day off
- 23 day's annual leave plus bank holidays
- Life assurance (4x salary)
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity and paternity policies
- Employee Assistance Programme and well-being support
- Training, mentoring, and development opportunities
- Annual appraisals and career progression
- Employee recognition and reward programmes
- Length of employment awards and increased holiday entitlement
- Branded uniform

If you're passionate about customer satisfaction and want to develop your career within a successful automotive business as a Service Advisor, we'd love to hear from you. Erin Lord is overseeing this role on behalf on E3's Recruitment client and can provide more information after a successful application, or you can contact our office for support.

title: Service Advisor
description:
Service Advisor
Location: Gloucester
Salary: £30,000-£34,000pa DOE
Hours: 42.5 hours per week
Monday to Friday: 07 30
Alternate Saturdays: 07 00

We are seeking a customer-focused and organised Service Advisor to join a busy commercial vehicle dealership in Gloucester.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong customer service skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing customer expectations, and ensuring the smooth running of workshop operations.

The Role

As a Service Advisor, you will be responsible for managing the customer journey from initial booking through to vehicle collection. You will coordinate workshop appointments, keep customers updated on repair progress, provide estimates, and gain approval for any additional work required.

You will also play an important role in maximising workshop efficiency, ensuring bookings are scheduled effectively and customers receive an excellent level of service.

Key Responsibilities of the Service Advisor:
- Deal with customers professionally, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction
- Book vehicles into the workshop, ensuring appointments align with customer needs and workshop capacity
- Keep customers regularly updated on vehicle progress, repair times, and completion dates
- Identify customer requirements and provide accurate, fully inclusive cost estimates
- Produce accurate job cards, invoices, estimates, and related documentation
- Explain completed work clearly and identify opportunities to promote additional services
- Gain customer approval for any additional work required
- Maintain accurate workshop loading and scheduling information
- Produce warranty job cards in line with manufacturer policies and procedures
- Correctly record retail, warranty, internal, and non-chargeable repairs
- Liaise with the Parts Department to ensure required parts are available

This role will suit you if you have:
- Previous experience in a Service Advisor role (preferred)
- Experience working in an administration or office-based environment
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks
- A commercial mindset with the confidence to identify additional sales opportunities
- The ability to work effectively with customers, technicians, and internal departments
- Kerridge system experience (preferred)

title: Administrator
description: Become an Administrator with purpose, where your contribution is part of helping to change people's lives. It's an administration role that's rewarding like no other. Join the team at The Dean Neurological Centre in Gloucester as an Administrator and be valued and supported. You will support the service's administration needs, including new starter paperwork, organising training and managing leave requests. You will liaise with new staff members as you manage and verify their compliance documents, including DBS checks, identification, references and Right-To-Work. As an administrator, being organised and keeping the general office function running smoothly will be second nature; files will be in the right place and kept confidential, post will be cascaded, phones will be answered in a friendly and helpful way, and spreadsheets will be up to date and logical. Working alongside senior staff members, you will manage staff absences and leave requests, maintain personnel files, and produce audits. As an Administrator at Elysium Healthcare, you will play a vital role in supporting the service's administration needs within The Dean Neurological Centre in Gloucester. Your responsibilities will include managing new starter paperwork, organising training, and handling leave requests. You will also liaise with new staff members to verify their compliance documents, such as DBS checks and identification. This role requires excellent organisational skills to ensure the smooth running of office functions. As an administrator, you will maintain confidentiality, manage personnel files, produce audits, and assist in developing effective systems. You will be the link between the public, other professionals, and hospital departments, handling routine telephone calls and inquiries. Additionally, you will make diary entries, book rooms and transport, maintain filing systems, and perform clerical duties as needed, ensuring confidentiality of all records. Become an Administrator with purpose, where your contribution is part of helping to change people's lives. It's an administration role that's rewarding like no other. Join the team at The Dean Neurological Centre in Gloucester as an Administrator and be valued and supported. That’s what delivering great healthcare should feel like. As an Administrator you will: Assisting in the development, implementation, and evaluation of effective means of systems within the unit, and between units and groups. Acting as a link between the public, outside professionals and other hospital departments and wards in respect of routine telephone calls and general enquiries. Making diary entries, room bookings and transport bookings as required. Maintaining as confidential, at all times, information regarding patients, staff and hospital business. Maintaining, evaluating, and updating the units filing and record keeping systems. Providing clerical/typing duties as required, ensuring confidentiality of all clinical/administrative records. To be successful in this role, you will have: Previous experience within a similar role and/or environment. Knowledge of healthcare terminology Previous experience of typing up medical reports and patient discharge letters GCSE English, C or above. Where you will be working: Tewkesbury Road, Longford, Gloucester, Gloucestershire, GL2 9EE The Dean Neurological Centre has 60 beds, which is on the outskirts of the town within easy commute from Gloucester, Cheltenham with good transport links. It specialises in slow stream rehabilitation where the emphasis is placed on maximising each individual's abilities, comfort and quality of life. Bedrooms are fitted with high dependency equipment, including ceiling track hoists, wall mounted suction and oxygen equipment., with all rooms adapted to individual requirements. There are also well-equipped therapy facilities and other facilities such as gardens, gym and minibus.
